summary: Iteration 6: Frontend testing of P2/P3/P4 features - Welcome screen, Leagues empty state, Rankings dark mode, Lineup dark mode, Home screen, Profile stats. All 6 screens render correctly with proper dark mode, content, and UI elements.
action_items: MINOR: Console warning 'Route ./config/sponsors.ts is missing the required default export' appears on every page load. sponsors.ts is imported but not exported as a React component (expected behavior since it's a config file, not a component). This may be an Expo Router misconfiguration but does not affect functionality.
MINOR: useNativeDriver warning on Expo web is expected and non-actionable on web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: P3 welcome.tsx: Name displayed via useLocalSearchParams correctly — 'Carlos!' shown in DC143C crimson. Text split across two Text components ('¡Bienvenido a FuchoMX,' + '[name]!') is a valid design choice.
P4 leagues.tsx: Empty state uses FlatList ListEmptyComponent correctly. The emptyList contentContainerStyle has flex:1 which allows proper centering.
P2 rankings.tsx: backgroundColor '#000000' on SafeAreaView container confirmed. Card items use '#1a1a1a'. Points value uses '#DC143C'. Dark mode implementation correct.
P2 lineup.tsx: Field background '#2d7a3f' (green pitch) confirmed. Submit button uses '#DC143C'. Black container on header confirmed.
Profile stats grid: 8 StatCard components rendered in 2-column flexWrap grid with width '48%'. All values show correctly even without auth (defaults to 0/-).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P2/P3/P4 features verified: (1) /welcome?name=Carlos renders FuchoMX logo, 🎉 confetti, crimson name 'Carlos!', red 'Crear mi liga' button, dark 'Unirme a una liga' button, 'Explorar primero' link. (2) /quiniela/leagues empty state shows 🏟️, 'Aún no tienes ninguna liga', subtitle, red 'Crear liga' button, underlined 'Unirme a una liga' link. (3) /quiniela/rankings shows black bg, #1a1a1a cards, white text, red points (DC143C). (4) /fantasy/lineup shows green pitch (2d7a3f), black header, red 'GUARDAR ALINEACIÓN' button. (5) Home shows FUCHOQUINIELA + FUCHOONCE cards on black bg. (6) Profile /MI ESTADÍSTICA shows 8 stat cards in 2-col grid with red values.
